title: Trading would be easier if I could just not click the damn button
summary: I started day trading early last year and my biggest issue wasn’t entries or strategy it was my psychology, I mean I was blowing accounts left and right and it made me want to k1ll myself honestly, I know it sounds bad but it was really messing with me cause I just wanted to be a successful trader and I was spending money left and right on accounts and then blowing them cause I was greedy or because I wanted to trade outside of my specific hours and not follow my ruleshttps://preview.redd.it/gzicuilkr0eg1.png?width=2832&format=png&auto=webp&s=222bc76f1d1dc20b52307f63c2d68514538822a9Anyways after blowing so many accounts, I realized I couldn't hold myself back no matter how hard I tried, so I built a simple tool for myself that helps me with my psychology, you guys don't have to try it at all but its helped me so if it can help you that's all that matters. I hope everyone reading this becomes successful at day tradinghttps://impulseaiapp.comsubmitted by/u/SethBright[link][comments]
